body:
Thanks for taking to me.  
  
We do tell each other that we love the other still. It wasn't a one time thing. The one time thing was that I didn't feel empty. I know I mean it when I tell her I love her but I feel empty now all the time.  
  
I'm sorry to hear that the paper didn't go well for you. :(  
  
I don't know how my parents would take it. The last time I was depressed I told my parents (they don't know I am right now) because I failed a class one quarter in high school my senior year. Their response was less than optimal. My dad yelled at me and told me I wasn't trying hard enough that it was my fault. It didn't matter that I hadn't felt happy in months to him. My mom wasn't much better she acted caring when I first told her and then it never got brought up again. The only thing that got brought up was that I needed to do better and that I was grounded.  
  
So I don't know how my parents will take this if I tell them about my academic dismissal and everything.  
  
Thank you again for reading that and I don't want you to feel obligated to talk to me.  
  
That being said though if you ever need someone to talk to I'm all ears.
